title: C26: a held 15m high/low is taken out later (base rates)

what.name: Held level
what.value_plain: 15m pivot = highest high (lowest low) of +-16 bars, pulled back >= 0.8%, retested within 0.4% without breaking, pivot <= 72h old; decision 1h after the retest
what.label: OURS

what.name: Control
what.value_plain: the same pivots at age-matched times, close 0.4-1.5% from the level, no retest condition
what.label: OURS

how: failed_retest_takeout.py counts how often and how soon the level breaks; no trade, no fees.
window: 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-31, split 2022-01..2024-06 vs 2024-07..now (whole history was read: a seen-period check, not a sealed test)

verdict.label: REAL but not a trade: taken within 24h 72% vs 59% control, both sides, both periods.

why: Operator's 10-31 chart: the 10-28 high held twice, was taken 19h later on 10-29, closed back under, then the drop.
The retest comes about 10h after the pivot; the take-out about 4-5h after the retest.
Use: a chart and dashboard line ('held level, likely taken'), not an entry on its own (arms A and B both failed).
